documentedConstraints.summary: Service endpoints are usually chosen by pod-label selectors, not by software/API compatibility or preview authorization.
Service selectors are equality maps; multiple requirements combine with AND. App-only equality can match multiple builds.
A capable Gateway implementation can weight different Service backends. Separate Deployments alone do not implement weighted user routing. No example resources or configuration are generated here.
AKS deployment reliability also needs workload-specific readiness, capacity and lifecycle settings. Route selection is not a proof of those settings or complete user continuity.
